title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha, an Indian southpaw, achieved a significant upset by defeating the World No. 2, marking a career highlight and a proud moment for Indian badminton.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha, the Indian southpaw, delivered a stunning upset at the French Open, defeating World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi 21-19, 21-18. This victory makes her only the second Indian shuttler, after PV Sindhu, to beat the Japanese star.

title: Sindhu Smashes Way Past Gunji to Enter French Open Quarterfinals
indian_angle: PV Sindhu, a prominent Indian shuttler, continued her strong performance at the French Open by securing a spot in the quarterfinals, maintaining her unbeaten record against Riko Gunji this year.
summary: PV Sindhu advanced to the French Open 2026 quarterfinals by defeating Riko Gunji. This win extends Sindhu's unbeaten streak against Gunji, having previously beaten her at the Singapore Open and Arctic Open.

title: National Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, highlighting the national federation's investment in future stars.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing junior players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The establishment of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures greater player representation in the governance of Indian badminton, a positive step for athlete welfare and decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the formation of its Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players' voices in the sport's administration.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is vital for nurturing young Indian talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: The Indian team is undergoing a coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.
